findings.note: The verifier reads SNAPSHOT.json before rejecting a symlink or junction, so it can access a linked path outside the package. Reject linked inventory paths before reading and add a focused test.
TIMESTAMP_RE accepts impossible calendar dates and offsets; it checks syntax but not an actual ISO-8601 datetime. Validate a real offset-aware datetime and test invalid values.

The documented rule that source_path appears only for package-doc entries whose path differs from the package path is not enforced; equal paths may include it and differing paths may omit it. Enforce or narrow the contract.

Real-source assembly/preservation, package-only verification, consumer install/defaults/update, human docs review, boundary/scan sweeps and traceability remain unchecked. Fixture tests do not establish these outcomes; report them as unverified.
The zero cloud footprint statement describes scope, not runtime worker isolation. Preserve the distinction: neither this plan nor fixture tests prove tool isolation.
